title: Product of Array Except Self
statement_short: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all the elements of nums except nums[i]. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time without using the division operation.
constraints: 2 <= nums.length <= 10^5, -30 <= nums[i] <= 30, product of any prefix or suffix is guaranteed to fit in 32-bit integer
hint: Array size up to 10^5 demands O(n) time, while the division ban requires accumulating prefix and suffix products.
why_not: Right: Prefix Sum (extended to prefix and suffix products) combines left-accumulated and right-accumulated products in O(n) time and O(1) extra space. Not Two Pointers: Two pointers cannot compute products for every position except the current index in O(n) total operations. Not Sliding Window: The product excludes a single element rather than calculating range aggregates over contiguous subsegments. Not Monotonic Stack: Maintaining monotonic order does not aid in multiplying all non-current elements.
